parse_model_flags: parse model command flags and extract provider, global, and model input from raw string arguments
resolve_alias: resolve a short model alias against a provider's models.dev catalog and return the resolved model ID
switch_model: execute the full model-switching pipeline including provider resolution, credential lookup, and metadata fetching
list_authenticated_providers: detect providers with credentials and return a sorted list of available providers with their curated models
is_nous_hermes_non_agentic: check if a model name matches Nous Research Hermes 3 or 4 chat models that lack agentic tool-calling capabilities
